data.state: Read-only review done; awaiting your choice between expiry fix and limiter cleanup.
data.target:
Find the highest-value maintainability fixes for the Tinylink repo, without editing files yet.
- Expiry is handled in one place: find() treats expired links as missing.
- Expired redirects and /stats/:code both return 404, with no click counted.
- Limiter memory cleanup is a separate, lower-priority follow-up.
- Run npm test before finishing any change.
data.recap:
- Read the repo without edits; identified three maintainability improvements.
- Expiry is inconsistent: find() returns expired links, and /stats reports them live.
- Expiry throw in async redirect handler may crash the process (unverified).
- Rate limiter's hits Map never removes IP keys, so memory grows.
data.next: Choose which direction to explore: the expiry fix or the limiter memory cleanup.

moves.label: Fix expiry in one place
moves.prompt: Make find() in src/store.js return null for expired links and delete them, remove the throw in src/server.js:34, and add tests: an expired redirect returns 404 with no click counted, and GET /stats/:code returns 404 for an expired code. Run npm test before you finish.

moves.label: Verify the crash, then fix
moves.prompt: Before changing anything, write a throwaway script outside the repo that creates a link with ttlSeconds: 1, waits 2 seconds, then requests /:code, and report whether the Node process crashes or returns a response. If it crashes, apply the expiry fix and add a regression test.

moves.label: Clean up limiter memory
moves.prompt: In src/limiter.js, delete an IP's key from the hits Map once its window is empty, add a test that the Map shrinks after the window passes, and run npm test.

ideasView.title: Return 400 for malformed JSON request bodies
ideasView.detail: Wrap JSON.parse in src/server.js:17 in try/catch and respond 400 on invalid JSON. Verify with a test that posts a malformed body and gets 400, not a crash.
ideasView.rationale: The unguarded parse throws inside an async handler, the same failure mode as the expiry throw.

ideasView.title: Evict empty IP entries from the rate limiter
ideasView.detail: In src/limiter.js, delete the key when its filtered timestamps are empty. Verify with a test that the Map size drops after the window passes.
ideasView.rationale: Memory grows with every distinct client IP and never shrinks.
